title: Castaway RV Park
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Castaway RV Park is conveniently located right off of I-45 Exit 211 in Streetman, TX approximately 74 miles south of Dallas, TX and 165 miles north of Houston, TX. It is located 14 miles from Fishermans Point Marina on Richland Chambers Reservoir which is the third largest inland reservoir by surface area.
